name: D ~Sono Keshiki no Mukougawa~
source:
The protagonist boards the ultra-luxurious sleeper express train "Magic Arrow" running through a certain country in Eastern Europe at the beginning of the 20th century. However, they get involved in a major accident on the train and are presumed dead. Yet, they somehow leap through time and space, returning to the past, several hours before the accident occurred.

Realizing that the future accident was orchestrated by someone, the protagonist teams up with a girl possessing magical abilities to manipulate time and space. Together, they embark on a journey to uncover the culprit, prevent the accident, and seize hold of a future that is yet to unfold.

[MTL from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ001514.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
20世纪初，主人公登上行驶于东欧某国的超豪华卧铺特快列车“魔法之箭”，却卷入一场重大列车事故，外界也认定其已经死亡。然而，主人公莫名穿越时空，回到事故发生数小时前。

意识到未来的事故是有人蓄意策划后，主人公与一名能够操纵时空的魔法少女联手，踏上寻找真凶、阻止事故的旅程，誓要夺回尚未到来的未来。

[译自 [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ001514.html]DLsite[/url]]
